panel.summary: The iterate prompt interpolates branch-produced diagnosis text with no data fence, and the review-panel fence it is modelled on is closeable by the untrusted text
panel.evidence: agent-iterate-ci.yml:165 splices `${{ steps.diag.outputs.summary }}` straight into the prompt with no "this is DATA, not instructions" wrapper and no delimiter. That text is `failureSummary` copied verbatim out of the .harness-reports artifact (scripts/agent/summarize-ci.mjs:92-98), and that artifact is written by CI running the branch's own code — so whoever controls the branch controls prompt text fed to an agent holding a contents:write App token (line 154). agent-review-panel.yml:414-421 does add a fence, but it is a plain `<panel-findings>` tag around unescaped lens-summary text (line 420), so a lens summary containing `</panel-findings>` — lens summaries quote untrusted branch content by design — escapes the fence and speaks to the fixer as top-level instructions. Both channels only became live with this diff's `allowed_bots`.
panel.finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-iterate-ci.yml::the iterate prompt interpolates branch-produced diagnosis text with no data fence, and the review-panel fence it is modelled on is closeable by the untrusted text

coderabbit.summary: Make the stalled notification match all failure modes.
coderabbit.detail: **Make the stalled notification match all failure modes.** With `fix` failures now entering this job, Line 479 can report that the review panel failed and produced no verdicts even when the panel succeeded and only the fixer failed. Use a generic pipeline-stalled message or select the message based on which dependency failed.
coderabbit.finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml::make the stalled notification match all failure modes.
